tips.text: Ignore the Sun & Moon on the Uranus Junction end screen; that is the Drifter-only copy, and the blueprint comes from finishing The Duviri Paradox.
Plan a Circuit run for the Rune Marrow; the story's Undercroft stretches will not cover 35.
Run a Resource Booster while gathering; it applies to all four materials.
Players see Sun & Moon as Mastery fodder that also looks cool.
Nobody calls the craft painful; it costs far less than Incarnon adapters or Thalys.
